description: Find which companies a business depends on for email, sign-in, DNS, website hosting, outbound email and SaaS, using public DNS only, and what a single outage would stop. Returns the layers, the vendors, a risk score and recommendations. Free, no key. Rate limited per connection and to about 20 fresh scans an hour; repeat scans of the same domain within an hour come from cache.

domain.description: The business domain, for example example.com.
